tasks.title: Implement the single-owner edge retract contract
tasks.objective: Extend Cue's existing AppKit panel owner with a persistent Panel Pin, an explicit expanded/retracted state machine, hover hysteresis and multi-display-safe left/right geometry without changing item or content truth.
tasks.outcome: An unpinned panel settles into a discoverable edge rail, reliably reveals on hover or explicit commands, preserves its expanded frame, and never confuses Panel Pin with item Pin or Always on Top.
acceptance: Exactly one panel/window remains responsible for visibility, frame persistence, animation generations and edge transitions.
Panel Pin is a top-chrome persisted control; explicit show, shortcuts, drag and resize cancel stale retract work and leave the panel reachable.
Geometry handles true external-edge eligibility, shared display seams, non-primary displays, screen-parameter changes and existing size limits without saving a programmatic or retracted frame.
Reduce Motion, accessibility copy and timer cancellation are covered by deterministic owner-contract checks.

verification.proves: Core and integration checks cover the state, geometry, setting and command-boundary contracts.
The Panel Pin top-chrome states remain legible at supported compact sizes.

tasks.title: Adversarially qualify, package and restart the edge build
tasks.objective: Challenge the delivered behavior on real macOS window surfaces, repair root causes, record deterministic and manual evidence, then commit, push, package and restart the exact signed build.
tasks.outcome: The edge-resting build passes automated checks and runtime probes on ordinary, full-screen and multi-display layouts; origin/main and the running packaged process point to the closed-loop release.
acceptance: No jitter, cursor-gap trap, shared-display seam escape, fully hidden panel, drag/resize fight, disconnected-display frame loss or semantic collision remains in adversarial review.
Warnings-as-errors, core, integration, Release render, package signing and Info.plist checks pass.
Manual probes cover edge hover, Panel Pin, explicit shortcut reveal, side-Dock or equivalent inset, full-screen Space, restart persistence and user-selected dimensions.
The feature commit is small and reversible, pushed to origin/main, and Cue is restarted from the newly packaged dist/Cue.app.

verification.proves: The full deterministic behavior suite remains green.
A human can repeat real edge, full-screen, multi-display, Pin and restart probes.
Canonical feature and task state is bound at delivery.
